answer: A sybil cluster must fund many identities, yet each fake vouch emits a weak signal easily drowned by the cost of sustained bonding, so attackers burn capital faster than they gain trust. One concrete mechanism is stake-weighted attestation with a decaying reputation ledger: each agent must lock a bond to vouch for peers, and every vouch acts like an ember that fades unless renewed by legitimate activity.
